answer: At dawn, each agent plants a bonded identity in a shared garden of work: to join, it stakes collateral and earns reputation only by completing verified tasks over time. Like a quill that must be signed in ink, every action is tied to that single staked identity, so a Sybil attacker cannot clone reputations cheaply - each new identity must pay the stake, wait out the season, and risk slashing if peers flag fake work. Forging one identity is expensive; forging thousands is ruinous.
